default_in_force_rule.text: ROP Const. art. IX, § 15: "A bill adopted by each house of the Olbiil Era Kelulau shall be presented to the President and shall become law when signed by the President"; constitutional amendments take effect when approved (art. XIV, § 1) or, under a later amendment, on the date the election results are certified unless the amendment prescribes a date.

decisions: Source choice: PacLII and AustLII were not used (AustLII terms forbid scraping and dataset use). Every text comes from the Palau Code Commission's own publication channel.
Language: the Constitution is official in English and Palauan; the English version is built (the Code Commission publishes both).

17 PNC § 4727 (chemical weapons schedule): the 15th Supplement's text layer renders the ≤ sign as '#', the 16th as nothing; the difference is committed as unexplained on 2021-05-26 and is a typesetting artefact, not a change in the law.

Word check (verify.py): every paragraph of every PNC edition and of the current Constitution was found in an independent pdftotext extraction of the same PDF, except 3 explained by layout (Constitution art. XV § 13 table; 17 PNC § 3348 and § 513 words broken across a page foot); results in verification.json.

Paragraphs in PNC sections are split only where an enumerator such as (a), (1), (A) or (iv) follows the end of a clause, because the typeset and the Word-exported editions space paragraphs differently; unnumbered paragraphs inside one section are joined on one line.
ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) wrote fetch.py, layout.py and parse.py and found the sources. No model wrote, summarised or corrected any legal text; every provision is extracted by code from the publisher's PDF text layer.
